author: Unity
description:
Catch up on the biggest announcements from the Unite Seoul 2026 Keynote in this condensed highlights video. 

Unity 7 was announced as the next major Engine release coming next year as a direct continuation of Unity 7. See what’s coming in the lead-up to Unity 7, from new graphics and rendering features, performance improvements, platform updates, Unity CLI and production pipeline features, and more from Unity’s latest roadmap. 

This supercut cuts through the full keynote to bring you the most important Unity Engine news, demos, features, and announcements in one video.

[00:00] Unity 7 Announcement
[00:28] CoreCLR
[02:12] Surface Cache GI
[04:40] 2D Enhancements
[06:03] Unity Neural & Upscalers
[07:58] Device runtime updates
[09:22] Unity Pipeline & CLI Demo
[12:49] Unity x Fortnite Demo
[14:08] XReal Aura & Meta XR


🔗 Watch the full Keynote: https://on.unity.com/UniteSeoulKeynote
🔗 Check out our Unity Roadmap: https://on.unity.com/UniteSeoul26_Roadmap
🔗 Share your feedback on our
title: The road to Unity 7 | Unite Seoul Keynote Engine highlights
